figma_error_auth_invalid: Figma rejected the stored credentials. Reconnect Figma to continue.
figma_error_file_not_found: That Figma file no longer exists, or this connection cannot see it.
figma_error_generic: Figma could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
figma_error_not_connected: Figma is not connected for this project.
figma_error_rate_limited: Figma is rate limiting us. Try again shortly.
figma_profile_description: Connect your own Figma account. Design names and previews are resolved once per project using the project's token, so this does not change what you see today — it is here for features that read Figma as you.
figma_project_description: A scoped Figma personal access token used to resolve designs for everyone on this project.
figma_project_help_step_dev_scopes_alt: Figma's token scope list, showing the two Development scopes ticked
figma_project_help_step_dev_scopes_body: Under Development, tick file_dev_resources:read and file_dev_resources:write. These let ProjectProject show the ticket on the frame in Figma's Dev Mode. Leave everything else unticked, then press Generate token.
figma_project_help_step_dev_scopes_title: Scroll down for the Development scopes
figma_project_help_step_scopes_alt: Figma's Generate new token dialog with the token name, expiry and first scopes
figma_project_help_step_scopes_body: Call it something you will recognise later, like ProjectProject. The expiry is up to you, but the token does not renew itself — when it lapses, designs stop resolving. Tick current_user:read, file_content:read and file_metadata:read.
figma_project_help_step_scopes_title: Name it, set an expiry, tick the first three scopes
figma_project_help_step_security_alt: The Personal access tokens section of Figma's security settings
figma_project_help_step_security_body: Click your avatar in the top-left of Figma, choose Settings, then the Security tab. Scroll to Personal access tokens and press Generate new token.
figma_project_help_subtitle: A personal access token lets ProjectProject read the designs this project links to. It takes about a minute to create.
figma_project_help_title: Where do I find a personal access token?
figma_project_help_trigger_label: How to create a Figma personal access token
figma_project_storage_required: Connect object storage before connecting Figma.
